categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in four segments: petrochemical new materials, industrial water treatment, hazardous solid waste treatment, and financial investment. Petrochemical new materials constitute the core business, accounting for over 82% of revenue, supported by industrial water treatment and hazardous waste management services. The company also engages in equipment manufacturing and environmental technology services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes mature production technologies for key petrochemical products such as isoprene, piperylene, dicyclopentadiene, hydrogenated C9, and C5 petroleum resins. It has developed proprietary technologies including polar modification of C5 petroleum resins, advanced hydrogenation and separation processes for C5 hydrocarbons, and integrated treatment processes for high-concentration organic wastewater. The company also employs electronic beam irradiation technology for wastewater treatment and advanced lithium extraction technologies from salt lake resources.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major petrochemical companies such as Sinopec Chemical Sales, Shuoyu Chemical (Huizhou), and Xiamen Guomao Petrochemical. The company serves industries including petrochemical, rubber, adhesives, coatings, construction materials, food packaging, medical materials, and environmental services. Its markets are primarily domestic, focusing on industrial clusters and chemical parks in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant facilities in Guangdong Province (Huizhou Daya Bay and Jieyang Danan Sea Petrochemical Industrial Zones), Jilin Chemical Park, and other regions including Ningxia, Shaanxi, Heilongjiang, and Qinghai. It has established subsidiaries and projects across northeast, northwest, north, east, and south China, with a focus on the South China petrochemical hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the petrochemical supply chain. It processes petrochemical by-products (C4 and C5 hydrocarbons) into high-value chemical materials and provides industrial water treatment and hazardous waste management services, positioning itself as a value-added processor and environmental service provider within the chemical industry supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the petrochemical new materials business, enhancing technology innovation in functional resins, thermoplastic elastomers, and high-end polyolefin materials. The company emphasizes R&D in advanced wastewater treatment, salt lake lithium extraction, and electronic beam irradiation technologies. It pursues industry-academia collaborations with top universities and focuses on product differentiation, cost reduction, and market expansion in high-value chemical materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of petrochemical new materials, industrial water treatment services, hazardous solid waste treatment services, engineering contracting, and financial investments. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance for product sales, and based on treatment volumes and contract terms for service businesses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a significant position in the Chinese petrochemical new materials sector, particularly in the C5 hydrocarbon derivatives market. It competes with other domestic and international chemical manufacturers and environmental service providers. Its competitive advantages stem from integrated industrial park locations, proprietary technologies, and diversified business segments supporting resilience against market fluctuations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.73 billion, a slight decrease of 3.21% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 35.57 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in 2023. Total assets grew by 13.57% to RMB 8.18 billion. The company has shown recovery in profitability and cash flow, supported by strategic investments and operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-value-added petrochemical new materials with proprietary polar-modified resins and advanced hydrogenation processes that improve product quality and application scope. It offers integrated environmental solutions combining industrial water treatment and hazardous waste management, leveraging technological innovation and strategic industrial park locations to provide stable supply chains and customized solutions. Its R&D capabilities and industry collaborations enable continuous product and process innovation, enhancing competitiveness.
